commit.message:
Record the bounded fold search below 222: no 221 found

The decomposed rotation-chain search (helper sub-goals per tagged pair and
read bit, levels 1-2 in full, level 3 local, zero run <= 7 along the way)
on the B + C 222 explored 75 / 5,443 / 14,253 tables and recorded 1,128
sub-goals; 24 pairs had chains for both read bits, but none composed into an
applicable fold with final zero run <= 6 (0 fold tables built). Both 222s
are also minimal under exact bisimulation and have no direct left-bit fold.
Bounded search, not a lower bound. Log in candidate-k222/variant-bc/evidence.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

read bit, levels 1-2 in full, level 3 local, zero run <= 7 along the way)
on the B + C 222 explored 75 / 5,443 / 14,253 tables and recorded 1,128
sub-goals; 24 pairs had chains for both read bits, but none composed into an
applicable fold with final zero run <= 6 (0 fold tables built). Both 222s
are also minimal under exact bisimulation and have no direct left-bit fold.
Bounded search, not a lower bound. Log in candidate-k222/variant-bc/evidence.
